claim.value: Keeping relevant events in separate logs may obscure their temporal sequence.
claim.scope: A possible limitation of the existing record arrangement.

provenance.rationale: P004 identifies separate logs, alongside missing entries, as potentially obscuring the sequence.

signal_basis.value: Relevant events occur in separate logs with some missing entries; the operation reconstructs their sequence by linking bookings to return, cleaning-completion and collection records by equipment and booking, preserving missing values.
signal_basis.scope: Reconstruction of the preceding six weeks of records during the two-week investigation.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans supply the record limitation and the linkage operation, including its time scope and treatment of missing values.
This component is inapplicable because the judgment is SUPPORTED.

rationale: Separate records require cross-log matching before the ordering of relevant events can be reconstructed. This licenses the modest possibility that the arrangement obscures the sequence; it does not require an unresolved empirical relation.
uncertainty: The claim does not establish that separation actually obscured a particular booking or caused late starts.
